title.narrative: Strengthening Sustainable Agriculture Practices for Scale-up

description.narrative: Many farm families living in the Dry Corridor of Nicaragua face low household incomes and food insecurity due to changing weather patterns and weak consumer markets. Women and young people, in particular, see few options for their future and their role in their communities is undervalued. At the IAF, we support community-led solutions to expand economic opportunity, advance social inclusion, and promote food security in Nicaragua. GPAE is working with small producers to improve organic and sustainable agricultural practices, develop access to new markets by educating consumers on the benefits of organic production, and promote inclusion and leadership for women and young people. It will also strengthen the network?s capacity to advocate for sustainable agriculture programs, policies, and practices nationwide. Amendment FY24 This amendment provides GPAE with an additional $60,000 and 12 months to further farmer resilience to extreme weather events and natural disasters, use technical assistance and demonstration farms to reach additional Nicaraguan farmers interested in sustainable agriculture, and improve market access and train the network?s marketing commission to increase sales and income. As part of the amendment, GPAE is mobilizing an additional $118,442 in counterpart resources to the grant agreement.
